title: Priority of Serving Parents
summary: Serving parents is prioritized over other deeds for seeking divine reward.
translation: If parents are alive, a man's greatest good fortune is to always be present in their service and promptly respond to their every call. This is the fundamental principle, as such opportunity to serve only exists while parents are living. Once they pass away, no amount of good deeds can truly replace this, not even striving in the path of Allah. A hadith reported by Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (may Allah be pleased with them) illustrates this: A man came to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and expressed his desire to pledge for migration and striving for the sake of reward from Allah. The Prophet (peace be upon him) asked if his parents were alive. He replied that both his father and mother were alive. The Prophet (peace be upon him) instructed that if he sought reward from Allah, he should return to his parents and treat them well. This indicates that if needed, serving one's parents should be prioritized over other non-obligatory acts if it leads to divine reward; otherwise, fulfilling obligatory duties is different. One should consider serving parents as a path to Paradise.
